method: Headlines collected via web search (fetch_news.py collector blocked in sandbox; use it for local/Actions runs). Entity sentiment scored by Claude during the weekly Cowork routine. sentiment = 0-100 D-favorability of coverage tone (matches existing dashboard sentimentScore semantics: >55 leans D, <45 leans R). candidateSentiment = 0-100 favorability of coverage toward that candidate personally. outletLean: -2 left ... +2 right (AllSides-style); null = unrated outlet, excluded from scatter.

races.matchup: Susan Collins (R, inc.) vs. Troy Jackson (D, presumptive; convention Jul 25)
races.summary: Troy Jackson effectively locked up the replacement nomination, winning the vast majority of pledged convention delegates ahead of the Jul 25 convention. Coverage shifted from Democratic disarray to consolidation, though Collins is portrayed as confident and Jackson as less tested statewide than Platner's insurgent coalition.

articles.headline: Troy Jackson effectively wraps up Maine Democrats' nomination to face Sen. Susan Collins
The frenzied sprint among Maine Democrats hoping to replace Graham Platner
Platner's voters are reeling as Maine Democratic Party races to choose his replacement

races.matchup: Hannah Pingree (D) vs. Bobby Charles (R) vs. Rick Bennett (I)
races.summary: Pingree holds a wide lead: the Jul 1 BDN/Siena poll has her at 50% to Charles's 36% with Bennett at 8%. Coverage frames the general as Pingree's to lose, with Bennett's independent bid the main wildcard.

articles.headline: Hannah Pingree leads Bobby Charles in Maine governor's race poll
Maine gubernatorial candidates trade barbs on first day of general campaign
Bobby Charles secures Republican nomination for governor

races.matchup: Stevens/El-Sayed (D primary Aug 4) vs. Mike Rogers (R)
races.summary: Two weeks from the Aug 4 primary, polls diverge: a Detroit News/WDIV survey has Stevens up ~7 while Tavern Research has the race tied; El-Sayed leads all candidates in fundraising. McMorrow's Jul 5 exit made it a two-way Democratic fight. Rogers draws little coverage while the D primary dominates.

articles.headline: Haley Stevens polls ahead of Abdul El-Sayed in key Michigan Senate test
Abdul El-Sayed tops Stevens, Rogers in Michigan Senate fundraising
New poll shows El-Sayed, Stevens statistically tied in Michigan's Democratic U.S. Senate primary

races.summary: Benson has opened a real lead: the polling average sits near Benson +5, a sharp reversal from late 2025 when James led by six in a three-way field. Duggan's May exit consolidated the anti-James vote, and Newsweek-style 'Democratic chances soar' framing now dominates; GOP coverage frets about enthusiasm.

articles.headline: Democrats' Chances of Beating GOP In Michigan Governor Race Soar: Charts
New polling: Benson leads James, Johnson, Duggan in Michigan governor race
Polymarket predicts Michigan governors race

races.matchup: Jon Husted (R, appt.) vs. Sherrod Brown (D)
races.summary: Still a genuine dead heat. A mid-June likely-voter poll gave Brown a narrow edge and the RCP average sits inside a point, while Husted retains Trump's endorsement and a fundraising machine. Analysts quoted across coverage agree no clear favorite has emerged; every public poll lands within the margin of error.

articles.headline: Sherrod Brown chances of ousting GOP's Jon Husted in Ohio Senate race — Polls
2026 Ohio Senate Special Election polls: Husted vs. Brown

races.summary: July polling gives Acton a slight edge as Ramaswamy's early lead keeps narrowing, driven by movement among women. But the structural coverage still favors him: unified GOP, Trump endorsement, and a $26.8M war chest (thanks to a $25M self-loan) against Acton's $11.5M raised. Outlets split on who's actually ahead.

articles.headline: Vivek Ramaswamy, Amy Acton nearly tied in Ohio gubernatorial race: Poll
2026 Ohio Governor polls: Ramaswamy vs. Acton

races.summary: The race is tightening: PPP (Jul 10-11) has Cooper +4, down from double digits, as GOP support coalesces behind Whatley. Cooper's $14.8M quarter and name-ID edge still anchor a pro-D coverage tilt, but 'Whatley gaining' is now the dominant frame.

articles.headline: Poll shows North Carolina Senate race tightening
Cooper raises $14.8 million in 3 months, new poll shows Whatley gaining ground
Cooper leads, but Whatley has a path

races.matchup: Jon Ossoff (D, inc.) vs. Mike Collins (R)
races.summary: Ossoff enters the general with a commanding position: a Fox News poll has him +13 over Collins, and his $20M second quarter (over $42M on hand) dwarfs Collins's $2.1M. Coverage is broadly favorable to the incumbent, with Collins leaning on Trump's endorsement to consolidate Republicans.

articles.headline: Sen. Ossoff, Rep. Collins release latest fundraising numbers for Georgia Senate race
Jon Ossoff leads Mike Collins by double digits in Georgia Senate poll
In Georgia's Senate race, tough choices ahead for the state's Jewish community

races.matchup: Rick Jackson (R) vs. Keisha Lance Bottoms (D)
races.summary: Fox's July poll shows meaningful ticket-splitting: 11% of Ossoff voters back Jackson for governor. Bottoms is better-liked (52/38 favorable) than Jackson (43/38), keeping coverage slightly D-tilted in a Toss-up open seat.

articles.headline: Jon Ossoff leads Mike Collins by double digits in Georgia Senate poll
Georgia Senate race 2026: Trump and Ossoff exchange attacks after Collins wins GOP nomination

races.summary: Iowa's open-seat Senate race stays a pure coin flip in coverage: NYT/Siena has Hinson +2 while Fox News has Turek +4, both within error. Turek's paralympian-to-legislator story keeps earning favorable profiles; Hinson holds the R-lean fundamentals.

articles.headline: Polls: Iowa's U.S. Senate campaign tight, Sand leads for governor
Josh Turek holds 4-point lead over Ashley Hinson in Iowa Senate race
Josh Turek leads Ashley Hinson in one of two new election polls; Rob Sand beats Zach Lahn in both

races.summary: Sand leads Lahn in both new polls (NYT/Siena 48-47; Fox News 53-44) with notable crossover support from Hinson voters. Coverage frames the open governorship as Democrats' best Iowa opportunity in a decade.

articles.headline: Polls: Iowa's U.S. Senate campaign tight, Sand leads for governor
Josh Turek leads Ashley Hinson in one of two new election polls; Rob Sand beats Zach Lahn in both

races.matchup: Joe Lombardo (R, inc.) vs. Aaron Ford (D)
races.summary: A rough week for Lombardo: bodycam video showed him invoking his name to avoid a red-light citation, drawing an 'abuse of authority' attack from Ford, while Newsom headlined the Democrats' canvassing kickoff. Polling still gives Lombardo a slight edge, but the coverage tone moved toward Ford.

articles.headline: Gov. Joe Lombardo abused his authority during traffic stop, Aaron Ford says
Newsom stumps for Ford and Horsford
New poll shows Lombardo has slight lead in 2026 governor matchup

races.matchup: D primary Aug 11 (Barnes, Hong, Crowley) vs. Tom Tiffany (R)
races.summary: A whirlwind Jul 17: Rodriguez suspended her bid over financial-reporting errors, and Milwaukee County Exec David Crowley re-entered the primary with outgoing Gov. Evers' endorsement, making Aug 11 a three-way Barnes-Hong-Crowley contest. Tiffany's $8M haul - mostly from the state GOP - leads all candidates. Coverage is even-handed with a slight D structural tilt in this open swing seat.

articles.headline: Wisconsin Lt. Gov. Sara Rodriguez drops out of governor's race
David Crowley reenters battleground Wisconsin's Democratic governor primary with Gov. Evers' backing
Tiffany reports over $8 million haul for gov race, while Barnes leads Dem field in fundraising

races.matchup: Katie Hobbs (D, inc.) vs. GOP primary Jul 21 (Biggs prohibitive favorite)
races.summary: Primary-eve coverage is all but coronating Biggs - one poll gives him a 50-point lead over Schweikert, and Robson's February exit left no establishment alternative. Hobbs, sitting on roughly $15M and a fresh Lean D rating from Cook, is consistently framed as the general-election favorite against a Trump-aligned nominee.

articles.headline: What to expect in Arizona's state primary on Tuesday
Arizona governor polling: GOP race a blowout

races.matchup: Chris Pappas (D) vs. John E. Sununu (R)
races.summary: UNH's July poll has Pappas up 47-44 on Sununu, with Sununu dominating his primary (59-20 over Brown) and Pappas's primary edge shrinking against Manzur. Coverage treats the open seat as Lean D but genuinely contested.

articles.headline: UNH poll shows tight races for governor and U.S. Senate
New Hampshire 2026: Sununu Leads GOP Nomination, Ties Pappas for Senate
Latest UNH Poll on NH's 2026 U.S. Senate Race: Pappas Holds Primary and General Election Edge as Sununu Consolidates GOP Field

races.matchup: Kelly Ayotte (R, inc.) vs. Cinde Warmington (D)
races.summary: Ayotte remains favored: first-term NH incumbents have lost only twice in a century, she won by 9+ in 2024, and UNH polling keeps her ahead. Coverage of her legislative record and Trump-proximity risk gives Warmington openings, but the race stays in the R-hold frame ahead of the Sep 8 primary.

articles.headline: Adversarial, aloof, agreeable: Ayotte's work with lawmakers at center of her reelection bid
Republican Kelly Ayotte and Democrat Cinde Warmington file for N.H. governor's race, trade barbs

races.matchup: Open seat (Kelly term-limited) - primaries Aug 4 (Masterson favored on R side)
races.summary: Voter-guide coverage dominates two weeks out from the Aug 4 primaries: Trump-endorsed Masterson is the clear R frontrunner over Schwab, with Holscher leading the D side. An economy-focused candidate forum drew even-handed coverage; the fundamentals still favor an R flip of Kelly's seat.

articles.headline: Meet the 2026 Candidates for Kansas Governor
What the Kansas gubernatorial candidates said about their plan to address the economy
Who's running for Kansas governor in 2026? Here's a guide to the candidates

races.matchup: Kurt Alme (R) vs. Alani Bankhead (D) vs. Seth Bodnar (I)
races.summary: The four-way general field is set (Alme-R, Bankhead-D, Bodnar-I, Austin-L), and the anti-consolidation problem is now explicit: 17 Democratic legislators publicly urged Bankhead and Bodnar to unify. Coverage continues to frame the split opposition as securing the GOP hold.

articles.headline: Four general election candidates to compete for Montana's open U.S. Senate seat
Democratic legislators want a consolidated U.S. Senate race in Montana
Divided Montana Senate field helps Republicans

races.matchup: Dan Sullivan (R, inc.) vs. Mary Peltola (D) — RCV, primary Aug 18
races.summary: Peltola vastly outraised Sullivan ($6.9M to just over $2M since Apr 1) heading into the Aug 18 top-four primary, and the same-named 'Dan Sullivan' challenger remains on the ballot after the court reversal. Forecasters split between Toss-up (Cook, Sabato) and Lean R (IE).

articles.headline: Peltola vastly outraises Sullivan in Alaska's U.S. Senate race
Alaska Division of Elections intends to strike U.S. Senate challenger Dan Sullivan from the ballot

races.matchup: Pete Ricketts (R, inc.) vs. Dan Osborn (I)
races.summary: A new statewide survey has the race in a statistical tie (Ricketts 48, Osborn 47), and Democratic nominee Cindy Burbank moved to withdraw on Jul 17 - pending an AG opinion - which would consolidate the anti-Ricketts vote behind Osborn. Coverage increasingly treats Nebraska as a genuine sleeper race.

articles.headline: NEW POLL: Dan Osborn is Tied With Pete Ricketts in Critical Nebraska Senate Race

races.summary: Talarico's $30M quarter - more than triple Paxton's $9M and $70M+ since launch - headlines the week, and Paxton's camp confirmed he will debate. Coverage of Paxton stays dogged by the impeachment record and a controversial plea deal; public polling remains essentially tied.

articles.headline: Ken Paxton's campaign says he will debate James Talarico in Texas' U.S. Senate race
Talarico more than triples Paxton's Q2 haul in Texas Senate race
Talarico's $30 Million Haul Crushes Paxton in Texas Senate Race

races.matchup: Greg Abbott (R, inc.) vs. Gina Hinojosa (D)
races.summary: Abbott stays favored — the RCP average has him +6.8 and stuck near 49 — but the narrowing storyline persists: Texas Public Opinion Research has it within 5, with Hinojosa winning independents, moderates, and Latino voters. A third of voters still don't know her, which reads as both ceiling and runway.

articles.headline: Democrat Gina Hinojosa launches first ad of Texas governor's race
2026 Texas Governor polls: Abbott vs. Hinojosa
